description: Rename the Legacy.Widgets namespace to Acme.Widgets across source, project file and tests
prompt:
Rename the namespace `Legacy.Widgets` to `Acme.Widgets` everywhere: the source files under src/Widgets, the `RootNamespace` in Widgets.csproj, and the `using` directives in tests/Widgets.Tests. No type names change.

`dotnet test tests/Widgets.Tests` must pass afterwards.
